summary.short: Vietnamese Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence, issued by the National Assembly on 10 December 2025, effective 1 March 2026 per the portal page. The document holds only metadata, not operative provisions, so obligations and addressees are not described.
summary.long: Law No. 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence (Luật Trí tuệ nhân tạo) is recorded on the government gazette portal as a law (Luật) issued by the National Assembly (Quốc hội) and signed by Trần Thanh Mẫn, with an issue date of 10 December 2025 and an effective date of 1 March 2026. The registry marks it as in force. The fetched document is the portal page, which carries the title, number, issuing body, dates and navigation material but not the text of the articles. Its mechanisms, thresholds, obligations, enforcement regime, definitions and addressees therefore cannot be annotated from this document and are not described. The territorial scope is likewise not stated in the fetched text. Annotation of operative provisions requires the full text of the law, such as the .docx or .pdf files linked on the portal page.

notes: The fetched document is the Công báo portal page for Law 134/2025/QH15. It contains metadata and navigation only, not the law's articles, so operative provisions could not be annotated. All related-document counters on the page (căn cứ, sửa đổi, thay thế, dẫn chiếu, hướng dẫn and their reverse lists) show [0], so no relations are recorded. Issue date 10/12/2025 and effective date 01/03/2026 appear only in portal metadata. Any legal basis for the law is not stated in the fetched text. Full consolidated text is needed before relations or other sections can be annotated.
